title: Sicily & Milos: 7-Day Mediterranean Itinerary — Taormina, Boats & Greek Islands
description: A personalized 7-day itinerary covering Taormina, Sicily and Milos, Greece — with specific restaurant picks, work-friendly scheduling, boat days, and island hopping logistics.

days.title: Arrive, Settle In & Your First Sicilian Sunset
days.description: You're both arriving from different continents — Rebecca from Tallinn, Bernard from Austin. Today is about getting to Taormina, checking in, and easing into la dolce vita. Don't overplan. The town is small enough that a casual evening stroll covers the highlights.

activities.name: Catania Airport → Taormina
activities.description: From Catania (CTA), take a taxi or pre-booked transfer to Taormina (~50 min, €60–80). Alternatively, the Interbus/SAIS shuttle runs to Taormina bus station (~€8/pp, ~1h15). Coordinate arrival times — if you land within an hour of each other, share the taxi. Check into your hotel. Drop bags, freshen up, and head out for a first walk along Corso Umberto I — Taormina's main pedestrian street that runs the length of the old town.

activities.name: Piazza IX Aprile & San Domenico Palace Aperitivo
activities.description: Walk Corso Umberto to Piazza IX Aprile — Taormina's main square with panoramic views of the bay and Mt. Etna. Watch the sunset from here, then head to the San Domenico Palace (Four Seasons) for aperitivo on the terrace. Yes, it's splurge-priced, but the views are unreal and you're on vacation. Make a reservation — they don't allow walk-ins.

days.neighborhoods: Saturday · Free Day · Greek Theatre · Castelmola · Isola Bella
days.title: Ancient Ruins, Hilltop Villages & the Best Dinner of the Trip
days.description: Your first full free day — no work, no constraints. Pack in the big sights today: the iconic Greek Theatre with its Etna backdrop, the medieval hilltop village of Castelmola, the stunning beach at Isola Bella, and a fine dining experience that Reddit calls "the best meal of my entire trip."

activities.name: Teatro Antico di Taormina (Greek Theatre)
activities.description: Built in the 3rd century BC and expanded by the Romans, this is one of the most dramatically sited ancient theatres in the world. The stage frames Mt. Etna and the coastline — go early (opens 9am) to avoid tour groups and get the best photos. Allow 1–1.5 hours.

activities.name: Castelmola — The Village Above Taormina
activities.description: A 30-minute uphill walk (or quick taxi/bus) to this tiny medieval village perched above Taormina. The views from up here are even more spectacular — you can see Etna, the coast, and Taormina below. Wander the narrow lanes, peek into the ruined castle, and stop at the piazza for an espresso.

activities.name: Isola Bella
activities.description: Head back down to Taormina and take the funivia (cable car, €3) down to Mazzarò Beach, then walk south along the waterfront to Isola Bella — a tiny island connected to the mainland by a narrow sand strip. The water is crystal clear and the snorkeling around the island is excellent. Rent a beach chair or just lay out on the rocks.

days.neighborhoods: Sunday · Free Day · Boat Day · Coast
days.title: Boat Day Along the Sicilian Coast
days.description: Your last fully free day before work starts tomorrow. Spend it on the water — a private or group boat tour along the Taormina coast is one of the top experiences in Sicily. Grottoes, hidden coves, Isola Bella from the sea, and lunch on the water.

activities.name: Taormina Coast Boat Experience
activities.description: Book a half-day or full-day boat tour departing from Mazzarò or Giardini Naxos. Options range from €50–80/pp for group tours to €300–500 for a private boat (4–6 hours). You'll see:

days.title: Morning Beach, Afternoon Work 💻 Work 4pm–12am
days.description: First work day! But here's the silver lining of working US hours from Sicily: your workday doesn't start until 4pm local time. That gives you a full, glorious morning to hit the beach, have a proper Sicilian lunch, and still be at your laptop by 4pm. Work until midnight, sleep in, repeat.

activities.name: Mazzarò Beach Morning
activities.description: Take the cable car down to Mazzarò Beach. The morning is the best time — less crowded, cooler, and the light on the water is incredible. Rent a lounger (€10–15) or find a spot on the free section. Swim, read, do absolutely nothing. You've earned it before a work shift.

activities.name: Work Session
activities.description: Back to the hotel by 3:30pm. Set up your workspace — hotel terrace, room desk, or lobby lounge. If WiFi is shaky, tether to your eSIM hotspot. Work 4pm–midnight Sicily time (9am–5pm CT).

days.title: Morning Culture, Afternoon Work 💻 Work 4pm–12am
days.description: Another work day, another free morning. If you didn't fully explore the Greek Theatre on Day 2, go back — mornings here are quieter and the light is different. Then browse the shops and grab lunch before logging on.

activities.name: Morning Walk: Villa Comunale & Hidden Taormina
activities.description: Start with the Villa Comunale (public gardens) — a beautiful terraced garden with sea views, originally built by a wealthy English woman. Then wander the side streets off Corso Umberto that most tourists skip. Every turn reveals a new view, a tiny church, or a local nonna hanging laundry. Pop into La Pignolata for exquisite cannoli — Reddit says they're the best in town.

activities.name: Work Session
activities.description: Same drill — hotel workspace, eSIM backup, work 4pm–midnight. Quick dinner option tonight:

days.title: Castelmola Morning Hike, Final Work Day 💻 Work 4pm–12am
days.description: Last work day and last full day in Taormina. Make the most of the morning with a hike up to Castelmola via the old footpath — different from the road you might have taken on Day 2. Then a farewell lunch at one of your favorites and one final work session.

activities.name: The Saracen Footpath to Castelmola
activities.description: Take the old footpath from Taormina up to Castelmola (~45 minutes uphill). It's a mix of stone steps and dirt paths through terraced hillsides with wildflowers and olive trees. The views get better with every switchback. Much more rewarding than driving. At the top, reward yourself with a view from the castle ruins and an espresso in the piazza. Stop at Al Saraceno on the way back for the panoramic views.

activities.time: 💻 Afternoon & Evening — Final Work Session (4:00 PM–12:00 AM)
activities.name: Last Work Session & Pack
activities.description: Work 4pm–midnight, pack between meetings. Tomorrow you're flying to Greece! Quick dinner tonight:

days.neighborhoods: Thursday · Travel Day · Catania → Athens → Milos
days.title: Arrivederci Sicily, Yassou Milos!
days.description: Travel day! Catania to Athens to Milos. It's a full day of transit but you end it on a Greek island. Allow plenty of time for connections — especially the ATH→MLO leg on small regional planes.

activities.name: Catania (CTA) → Athens (ATH) → Milos (MLO)
activities.description: Leg 1: Taxi Taormina → Catania Airport (~50 min, €60–80). Flight CTA → ATH on Aegean Airlines (~1h45). Leg 2: Athens → Milos on Olympic Air or Sky Express (~45 min). If you booked separate tickets, leave at least 3 hours between flights for any delays and terminal transfers.

activities.name: Arrive & Settle In
activities.description: Milos airport is tiny — you'll be in your accommodation within 20 minutes. Drop bags, shower off the travel day, and head out for your first Greek dinner.
